scope: Strict pre-generation audit of the 12 batch-3 reference photographs
method: Each image was inspected directly and its identity was cross-checked against at least two independent results: the hosting file page plus an official manufacturer/archive source or an independent specialist source. Pass requires the correct model/generation, an unobstructed recognizable front, and a sufficiently factory-standard configuration for frontal reconstruction.

items.reason: Replacement is an official Škoda Auto archive photograph of a standard production Garde. The complete factory grille, rectangular lamps, bumper, bonnet and mirrors are unobstructed; no auxiliary rally lamps or aftermarket bonnet parts remain. The moderate three-quarter perspective is sufficient for frontal reconstruction.
visibleChecks: Official archive caption identifies Škoda Garde (1981)
rectangular lamps, narrow grille and original bumper match factory material
complete unobstructed standard front without add-ons

sources.role: replacement reference and official model identification
